title: Reports & KPIs
subtitle: Advanced analytics on operational performance
pdfUnavailable: PDF generation is disabled on this server

resolutionTime.title: Resolution time
resolutionTime.description: Average and median time between creation and completion, by task type.

completionOutcome.title: Success rate
completionOutcome.description: Positive vs negative completion ratio, by task type.

sla.title: SLA compliance
sla.description: BTs tracked under an SLA vs those that breached, by task type.

throughput.title: Daily throughput
throughput.description: BTs created and completed per day over the range.

mileage.title: Mileage
mileage.subtitle: Round trip base → site → base of the work orders completed in the period, computed by the routing engine or entered by hand.
mileage.empty: No work order completed in the period.
mileage.hint: The CSV lists every work order (reference, client, address, date, km, minutes, source). Work orders without km have no geocoded address or the base address was not set: “Recompute” on the work order fills them.
